ai.balance: The Agency has insufficient credits. Please contact the Owner.
ai.limit: You have reached your credit limit for this period. Please contact the Owner.
ai.price: This AI operation has no enabled price. An Admin must configure it first.
ai.account: The Agency credit account has not been funded. Please contact the Owner.
ai.schema: Credit and AI execution database migrations are required before generating content.
ai.pending: This AI request is still running. Do not regenerate as a retry of the same request.
ai.unknown: The AI outcome is not yet known. Credits may remain held for reconciliation; no automatic refund or regeneration.
ai.failed: AI produced no usable result. Reserved credits for this request have been released.
ai.conflict: This request key was used with different content. Please reload the page.
ai.workspace: Select a Workspace before using AI.
ai.notice: AI uses Agency credits. The price is fixed on submission; video credits stay held until a result is known.

pendingIntegration: AI generation through Business is connected to Credit. Payment/subscription funding is not automatic yet. Unknown AI outcomes keep credits held for reconciliation.
zeroHint: Enter a non-negative whole number. A zero limit blocks usage; it does not mean unlimited.
zeroPriceHint: Enter a non-negative whole number. A zero price is explicitly free, not unconfigured.

policy.title: Default member limit
policy.description: Applies to members without an override. Without an Agency default, the system uses 10 credits per period. This is a spending ceiling, not a credit grant.

owner.title: Owner: no personal limit
owner.description: Owner spending is still tracked and cannot exceed the Agency's shared balance.

member.choose: Select a member to view usage and adjust their limit.
member.title: Member limit

source.SYSTEM_DEFAULT: Using the system default: 10 credits per period. Saving here creates an individual override.
source.OVERRIDE: This member has an individual limit. Changes apply only to this member.
source.AGENCY_DEFAULT: Using the Agency default. Saving here creates an individual override.
source.UNCONFIGURED: Neither a default nor an individual limit is configured. This does not mean unlimited.
source.OWNER_UNLIMITED: The Owner has no personal limit.

price.title: AI Credit pricing
price.missing: No price configured for this operation. This does not mean free.
price.versionHint: Each save creates a new revision; accepted jobs retain their original price. Content/hashtags are billed per successful request; images/videos per successful output.

errors.integer: Enter a whole number between 0 and 9,007,199,254,740,991, without decimals or exponent notation.
errors.unsafe: This value cannot be represented precisely in the browser. Editing is disabled to protect the stored data.
errors.stale: Configuration changed. Your input is preserved; reload the saved version before editing again.
errors.schema: The matching Credit schema is missing. Review the configuration, accounting, AI execution and DEV_SEED-source migrations; never run init on an existing database.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to view or change this configuration.
errors.generic: Credit data could not be processed. Retry; unsaved input is never sent automatically.
errors.account: The Agency Credit cycle has not been established. Subscription/payment provisioning must be integrated before period reports are available.
errors.notFound: The Agency or member was not found within your current access.

balance.title: Agency Credit balance
balance.help: Available balance already excludes held credits. Plan credits are used first; purchased credits do not expire. Personal limits are not separately allocated funds.

usage.title: Current-period usage
usage.ceilingNote: A personal ceiling is not a wallet balance.
usage.remainingHelp: Remaining ceiling = limit − used − held, with a minimum of zero. Actual availability also depends on Agency funds, pricing and permissions. The Owner has no personal ceiling.
usage.empty: No Credit usage recorded for this period.

catalog.title: AI operation prices
catalog.description: Current prices for reference. Jobs retain the price version accepted at submission, not the latest price at completion.

unitName.image: Billed per successful image; character sheets count output images, not panels within an image.

topup.title: Top Up Agency Credits
topup.description: Expand creative quotas with specialized credit packages for your Agency.
topup.payosNote: Instant payment via VietQR / PayOS. Credits are credited immediately upon QR scan.

warning.warningDesc: Using between 75% - 90% of period quota. Consider adjusting limits.
warning.dangerDesc: Exceeded 90% of period quota! AI jobs may be blocked upon reaching ceiling.

presets.confirmDesc: Are you sure you want to update credit limit for this member to {{amount}} credits/period?
